title: Dr.G Expands Its Presence in the U.S. as L’Oréal Leverages TikTok Shop for Growth
summary: The digital acceleration arrives less than two years after L’Oréal acquired the dermatologist-led brand, founded by Dr. Gun-Young Ahn.

extraction.key_fact: 로레알이 틱톡샵을 활용해 닥터지의 미국 시장 내 입지 확장에 나섰다.
